purpose: Generate separated production-ready visual assets for a polished aquarium mobile game. Fish assets are intentionally excluded.

global_art_direction.style: polished casual mobile game, premium aquarium simulator, bright family-friendly underwater theme
global_art_direction.rendering: high-quality 2D game art with soft 3D-like shading, glossy highlights, clean silhouettes, crisp edges
global_art_direction.lighting: soft underwater sunlight from top center, subtle caustic highlights, gentle ambient glow
global_art_direction.quality: production-ready, not concept sketch, not placeholder, not AI-looking, no messy artifacts

export_rules.background: transparent for isolated UI, icons, particles, and decorations; full background only for environment background layers
export_rules.shadow: soft game-style contact shadows only where needed
export_rules.outline: clean soft outline or rim highlight, not thick black cartoon outline
export_rules.text: only include text when the asset specifically requires UI text

layering_note.important: The bubble button is a reusable glass asset. Place the bubble frame behind all menu/action icons. Icon assets should be generated separately without bubbles baked in.

common_coin.usage: basic currency, common rewards, normal purchases

rare_coin.usage: rarer rewards, upgrades, special shop items

super_rare_coin.usage: premium or very rare rewards, high-value unlocks

total_wealth.usage: combined total value of all currencies/assets
total_wealth.recommended_icon: treasure chest with mixed yellow, blue, and purple coins/gems

background_water.prompt: Create a clean polished underwater aquarium background for a portrait mobile game screen. The background should be a calm blue water gradient with soft sunlight rays coming from the top center, subtle bubbles, tiny floating particles, and very faint distant silhouettes of rocks and aquatic plants near the far left and far right edges. The middle gameplay area must remain clean, open, and low-distraction so fish and UI are easy to read. Use premium casual mobile game art style, soft 2D/3D hybrid rendering, turquoise and deep blue palette, gentle depth fade, no foreground sand, no fish, no UI, no buttons, no text, no coins, no decorations in the center.
background_water.negative_prompt: no fish, no UI, no text, no icons, no coins, no treasure chest, no foreground sand, no cluttered coral wall, no busy reef, no dark muddy colors, no photorealistic ocean, no horror, no deep sea darkness, no black borders

composed_screen_reference_prompt.prompt: Create a polished production-quality portrait mobile aquarium game screen. Use a clean separated background and foreground layer concept. The foreground is a clear sandy bed occupying the bottom 22 to 28 percent of the screen, crisp and bright with a clean open center where players can place decorations. Place decorations only near the left and right edges. Include status rows Tank L4, Fish 7/22, Coin 5/5, Food 11%, Clean 0%, Happy 11%, Collect coins H7 Hu0 I0. Add left side bubble buttons Food x2 and Herb x9. Add right side glossy bubble menu buttons Shop, Care, Book, Goal, Set with icons centered inside reusable glass bubbles. Add floating coins and reward text +7 and +11. Keep fish layer implied but do not generate fish as separate assets in this pack.
